summary: Counselling Psychologist with over five years of clinical practice across schools, employee assistance programmes and private practice, working with individuals, couples and groups on anxiety, grief and workplace stress.
pitch: I am a counselling psychologist with over five years of clinical practice across employee assistance, educational and private-practice settings. My work covers anxiety, grief and workplace stress, and I work primarily from CBT, mindfulness and systemic approaches. I hold an M.Sc. in Counselling Psychology from Rivertown State University.
